drakhanos.name: Drakhanos, First Blade
drakhanos.description: Raphazarus's right hand. They say he's never lost a duel — because no opponent has survived to tell about it.

legionAcier.name: Raphazarus's Steel Legion
legionAcier.description: A squad forged by 47 years of war. They fight as one man, and die like no one else.

vorne.name: Vorne the Executioner of the Arc
vorne.description: He executed deserters during the Great War. Raphazarus woke him up just for you.

soeurKaln.name: Sister Kaln, War Widow
soeurKaln.description: She lost everything in the Fracture. Raphazarus gave her a new purpose: stop you from finishing what he started.

spectre.name: The Ghost of the Lost Front
spectre.description: A veteran the war never let go of. He strikes from angles you never see coming.
